name: My Group Members Suck!!
source:
As the appointed group lead for a university usability project, Aini's spent weeks conducting user interviews and compiling notes. But now, with the deadline in 5 days... none of her group members want to work!

As the deadline ticks down, Aini must navigate private messages and group conversations. Will she prioritise getting the assignment done or being a compassionate leader? 

[From [url=https://tenshistudios.itch.io/my-group-members-suck]itch.io[/url]]
